name: Sega 32X
description: A mushroom-shaped add-on that plugged into the Mega Drive / Genesis cartridge slot, adding two 32-bit SH-2 processors and a new video layer. Released at the end of 1994 as a stopgap before the Saturn, it was abandoned within about a year.

specs.graphics: 32X VDP framebuffer overlaid on Mega Drive video, up to 32,768 colours

curiosities: It needed its own power adapter, so a full Mega Drive + Mega-CD + 32X setup used three power supplies.
A single-unit Mega Drive with built-in 32X, code-named Neptune, was announced but never released.
It plugs into the Mega Drive's cartridge slot, and ordinary Mega Drive games are played through it.
story: Sega of America pushed for a cheap way to bring 32-bit games to the Genesis while the Saturn was being finished. The 32X add-on launched in November 1994.
It plugged into the Genesis cartridge slot and needed its own power supply. Virtua Racing Deluxe, Star Wars Arcade and Knuckles' Chaotix were among its few games.
Released just before the Saturn, it confused players and was dropped within a year.
